feedback: The confession fits the available chain: Elon attended the open preview, visited the unattended glass, and defended a feed that could not operate without camera power. Calling the panel a saved image makes explicit the implication already available from the sample-image note and rejected installation invoice. The poison-taking and dosing are newly admitted actions, rather than a new forensic mechanism or surprise witness. His shame about selling an unbuilt system follows his earlier financial and reputational pressure. I found the motive emotionally credible and my accusation rewarded, although the confession settles a choice that the shared physical evidence had not conclusively separated from other possible users. Brie's and Cary's ordinary admissions make satisfying human consequences without erasing that uncertainty.
